Subject: Security artifacts needed for AWS/GCP co-sell onboarding

Hi Kimberly,

We're progressing Atlas Health's internal review for the AWS/GCP co-sell listing (DEAL-5841). Procurement and our security team have a tight window to complete vendor checks before the procurement board meets on 2027-05-20. Can you provide the following artifacts so we can move to contract and listing steps?

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted acceptable)
- Pen test attestation or letter from the testing vendor
- Executed DPA or a redlined DPA for our legal team

If there's anything else needed for Marketplace (attestation that the service is isolated in us-east-1, data residency statements), please include that. Our security reviewer is Mike Chen (mike.chen@atlashealth.com) — please CC him on the artifacts.

Can you confirm ETA? We're hoping to have artifacts in hand by 2027-05-12 to remain on track.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior InfoSec Manager
Atlas Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: Elena Morales <security@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security artifacts needed for AWS/GCP co-sell onboarding

Elena — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We're committed to supporting the review and can get most of this to you quickly. Summary of what we can provide and ETA: 

- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (2026 reporting period): we can deliver a redacted PDF by EOD 2027-05-11.
- Pen test letter from SecureVision (third-party tester): confirmed — will attach a signed letter now, and the full vendor statement by 2027-05-10.
- DPA: we've attached a redlined DPA (v3) for your legal team to review. If you prefer DocuSign, we can route it for signature once redlines are accepted.

Notes on scope: our production tenant for Atlas will be hosted in AWS us-east-1 with encryption at rest and in transit. The SecureVision engagement was scoped to external penetration testing and a limited internal review of the control plane (no access to customer data stores). If Mike needs more granular scope language, Jordan can follow up.

I've attached the pen test letter and the DPA redline to this reply for immediate review. We'll upload the SOC 2 redacted PDF to a shared Drive link and send the DocuSign route for the DPA if you confirm.

Attachments: pen_test_letter_securevision_2026.pdf; DPA_redlined_v3.docx

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

"SecureVision confirms that the penetration test performed against Redwood Inference's production service (hosted in AWS us-east-1) as of 2026-11-15 resulted in no critical findings that would preclude a cloud marketplace listing. The assessment covered external network attack surface and a limited internal control-plane review; data stores were not directly accessed during testing."

We are attaching the signed pen_test_letter_securevision_2026.pdf to this thread (also uploaded to the Drive).

Next steps we propose: 
- We will upload the redacted SOC 2 Type II to the Drive by 2027-05-11 18:00 PDT.
- Kimberly will initiate a DocuSign envelope for the DPA redlines today — if Atlas legal approves the redlines, we can have an executed DPA within 48 hours.
- Once the artifacts are in your portal, we request confirmation that the listing can be advanced to "Ready for Marketplace" so AWS co-sell can proceed.

Relevant links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-atlas-compliance (artifacts), https://hubspot.example.com/deal/5841
